## Goal

The skeleton everything else hangs on: the data structures for the plasma state, the guard
every surrogate will sit behind, the coupling loop, translation to and from IMAS, provenance
records, and a test suite, all running on a toy physics model so that each piece can be
checked before real physics arrives.

## Acceptance criteria (fixed in the brief before work started)

| criterion | result |
|---|---|
| IMAS round trip preserves values and coordinates to machine precision, for all four record types | **met**: [10^−14^]{.claim}[C-024](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-024){.cid .st-tested} relative, including a file round trip |
| a toy transport model runs 100 steps inside compiled code | **met**: [100 steps]{.claim}[C-001](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-001){.cid .st-tested}; [0.4 s]{.claim}[C-025](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-025){.cid .st-measured} once compiled |
| continuous integration green | **pending**: the workflow runs on the code's private hosted repository since 1 Oct 2026 ([OQ-3](/Blog/toktoit/decisions.qmd#oq-3)); its first result is not yet recorded here. Locally: lint and type checks clean, [42 tests]{.claim}[C-029](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-029){.cid .st-measured} passing, in both modes |

There was no human gate at M0.

## What was built

- **Plasma state** as immutable data structures: radial grid, profiles, equilibrium,
  transport coefficients and sources, each field documented with its unit. See
  [core state](../technical/core-state.qmd).
- **Open/gated separation**: every module labelled, a registry of gated codes, and a switch
  that disables them all; two tests enforce it. See [invariants](../technical/invariants.qmd).
- **The guard**: input domain, ensemble-spread tolerance, physical output bounds and
  finiteness, with a per-point fallback. See [guard](../technical/guard.qmd).
- **Uncertainty carried through the loop**: the ensemble spread travels with the transport
  coefficients, is zeroed where the fallback is used, and is exported as IMAS error bars.
- **The coupling loop**, built one milestone early because M0 needs something to run the toy
  model in. See [coupling loop](../technical/coupling-loop.qmd).
- **Toy physics**: circular equilibrium, smooth critical-gradient transport, Gaussian sources.
  See [physics models](../technical/physics-models.qmd).
- **IMAS adapters** for four record types. See [IMAS adapters](../technical/imas-adapters.qmd).
- **Provenance** beside every artifact. See [provenance](../technical/provenance.qmd).

Checks beyond the acceptance criteria: particle and energy balance of a single step to
[10^−10^]{.claim}[C-026](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-026){.cid .st-tested}, and of every step of a full run reconstructed from its record to
[10^−9^]{.claim}[C-027](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-027){.cid .st-tested}; derivatives through 20 coupled steps agree with finite differences to
[2 × 10^−5^]{.claim}[C-028](/Blog/toktoit/claims.qmd#c-028){.cid .st-tested}.

## Deviations from the brief, and why

- **The coupling loop arrived at M0, not M1**, because M0's acceptance needs a running loop
  and the guard and uncertainty plumbing had to be designed against it.
- **A final "corrector" solve** was added after the nonlinear iteration (not in the brief's
  sketch), so the accepted state conserves particles and energy exactly for the coefficients
  that are recorded, however well the iteration converged. See
  [coupling loop](../technical/coupling-loop.qmd).
- **Picard iteration stalls** on stiff transport. The toy model's settings were softened to
  get through M0 and the stall was reported, not hidden; Newton-Raphson was recommended for M1
  and approved ([OQ-4](/Blog/toktoit/decisions.qmd#oq-4)).
- Two open-source codes needed at M1 (ASCOT5, Aurora) would not build yet.

## What M1 needed from the owner

A hosted repository so CI runs ([OQ-3](/Blog/toktoit/decisions.qmd#oq-3), settled); a benchmark scenario ([OQ-6](/Blog/toktoit/decisions.qmd#oq-6), settled) and its
tolerance ([OQ-5](/Blog/toktoit/decisions.qmd#oq-5), settled); a decision on the Newton solver ([OQ-4](/Blog/toktoit/decisions.qmd#oq-4), approved) and on the fallback
model ([OQ-1](/Blog/toktoit/decisions.qmd#oq-1), open); and permission to use the cluster's batch system ([OQ-2](/Blog/toktoit/decisions.qmd#oq-2), settled).
